# Lab 6.5: Create, Disable & Delete a Service Account

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a service account, see its email and unique ID, disable it, enable it again and delete it, including how to undelete.

## Steps

1. **Create a service account.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts create lab-app-sa \
  --display-name="Lab app service account" \
  --description="Used in Lab 6.5"</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **Look at its details.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts describe lab-app-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Note the **uniqueId**. You need it to undelete.

3. **See it in the console.** Go to **IAM & Admin → Service accounts**. The account shows as **Enabled**.

4. **Disable it.** A disabled account cannot authenticate, but keeps its roles.


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts disable lab-app-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com
gcloud iam service-accounts enable lab-app-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   Disabling first is a safe way to check that nothing depends on an account before you delete it.

5. **Delete and undelete.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts delete lab-app-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com --quiet
gcloud iam service-accounts undelete UNIQUE_ID</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


6. **Delete for good.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">gcloud iam service-accounts delete lab-app-sa@$PROJECT_ID.iam.gserviceaccount.com --quiet</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Disable | Stops authentication, keeps roles |
| Delete | Can be undone for 30 days with the unique ID |
| Same name later | A new account with a new unique ID |
| Old role bindings | Do not apply to a recreated account |
